movements.name: Arch roll
movements.description: Roll out the arch of your foot with a lacrosse ball. Use only the pressure of your foot. Do not stomp. Overdoing this will aggravate your foot. Reps mean slow passes along the arch.

movements.name: Toe flex
movements.description: Cross one leg over the other knee, then flex your toes back and forth. Be gentle. You can use your hand to assist the movement.

movements.name: Small shoulder circles
movements.description: Put your arms out and make small circles. Do it both directions. Reps mean circles in one direction. Then do the same number the other way.

movements.name: Large arm circles
movements.description: Make large arm circles. Do both directions. Reps mean circles in one direction. Then do the same number the other way.

movements.name: Ankle stretch
movements.description: Step one foot in front of the other. Bend the front knee and keep the back foot flat on the ground. You should feel the stretch in the back foot's ankle, in the Achilles tendon. Hold, then switch which foot is back. Sets mean one hold per side, counted in seconds.

movements.name: High plank
movements.description: Get on your hands and toes. Hands under your shoulders, arms straight, body in a line from your head to your heels. Brace your belly. Don't let your hips sag or pike up. Sets are holds, counted in seconds.

movements.name: Forearm plank
movements.description: Same line as a high plank, but on your forearms. Elbows under your shoulders. Brace your belly and keep your hips level. Sets are holds, counted in seconds.

movements.name: Dead bug
movements.description: Lie on your back with your arms toward the ceiling and your knees bent over your hips. Reach one arm straight behind your head and straighten the opposite leg, both hovering off the floor. Bring them back, then switch. Keep your lower back down. Reps mean one reach. Alternate sides.

movements.name: Leg raises
movements.description: Lie on your back with both legs straight and about an inch off the floor. Raise them together until they point up, then lower back to an inch. Don't set your heels down. Reps mean one raise and lower.

movements.name: Toe touches
movements.description: Lie on your back with your legs straight and your arms out in a T. Keep one leg fairly straight and sweep it across toward the opposite hand. Alternate sides. Reps mean one sweep.

movements.name: Scorpion
movements.description: Lie on your stomach with your legs straight and your arms out in a T. Bend one knee and reach that leg across toward the opposite hand. The knee bends. You will not keep the leg straight. Alternate sides. Reps mean one reach.

movements.name: Hip circuit
movements.description: Start on your hands and knees for every move. Hands under your shoulders, knees under your hips. Do the whole list on one side, then switch sides. Each set is the next move. After kick back, dancer's leg is extra: kick the leg straight back, sweep it out to the side while keeping it straight, then return to straight back.

steps.name: Fire hydrant
steps.cue: Keep the knee bent and lift that leg out to the side until the thigh is about level. Lower it.

steps.name: Knee circle
steps.cue: Lift the knee out to the side, carry it back behind you, then lower it to about an inch above the floor.

steps.name: Reverse circle
steps.cue: Kick the leg back first, open it out to the side, then lower it to about an inch above the floor.

steps.name: Kick back
steps.cue: Hover the knee about an inch off the floor, then kick the leg back until it is nearly straight. Bring it back.
